name: uv-sbom
description: uv export --format cyclonedx1.5: a CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM of a Python project's uv.lock.
title: uv-sbom

llmHints.on_match: uv export observed. Only --format cyclonedx1.5 (a preview feature: --preview-features sbom-export) writes an SBOM; write it to sbom.cdx.json with -o so the sbom attestor captures it. The default format is requirements.txt, which is not an SBOM.

positiveSetup: Invoke cilock with argv starting "uv export"
negativeSetup: Invoke cilock with unrelated argv (e.g. `echo unrelated`)
